hops.note: UBI-245 token method applied against a genuinely empty categories.json (real classification: 0 clean, 0 ambiguous, 444 no-signal, reported before authoring anything). Real signal used: Cloudflare's own 551 human-authored OpenAPI tags, the same signal namespace_from_tags already uses for wire grouping. 426 of 444 tokens normalized directly from real tag text; 18 carried an internal non-human tag and were individually traced to real wire types/paths, collapsing onto 9 real Cloudflare products. Real result: 433 distinct category labels for 1088 wire types, 100% coverage verified both by direct computation and a real ubx-docs-providers sidebar build against a local mirror. Not forced coarser than the real product taxonomy warrants. One key (cloudflare_location) later removed once the wire-type set itself changed -- see write-intros hop's own notes.

Real wire-type set is now 233 resources + 823 data sources (1056 total) -- two ubx-provider-dynamic create-binding fixes landed since categories was authored (see sdk/providers/.onboarding/cloudflare.json in ubiquex for the full account), dropping 268 -> 233 real resources. categories.json's own coverage re-verified against the new set: 966 of 967 keys still needed (cloudflare_location, which never had a real create OR real data source once both fixes landed, removed).

Batch 1 (commit https://github.com/Ubiquex/ubx-sdk-cloudflare/commit/70de50c, on the still-open PR #2 branch, not yet merged): 50/1056 wires, real content read against each wire's own create/read path and vendor field descriptions, not template text. Two real noun-derivation defects found and flagged directly in the intro text rather than worked around: cloudflare_commit is really an Artifacts (container registry) repository, not a commit; cloudflare_cost is really an AI Gateway custom-provider registration, not a cost record -- both share a real generated-name mismatch with several sibling wires (cloudflare_custom_domain, cloudflare_custom_provider, and others not yet reached alphabetically -- cloudflare_dataset, cloudflare_evaluation, cloudflare_gateway all bind to the identical AI Gateway create endpoint under different generated names). Renaming is out of this batch's own scope (create-binding correctness, not noun quality) -- recorded here so a future noun-quality pass has a real, concrete list to start from instead of rediscovering it.

Remaining: 1006/1056 wires still need an intro (233 resources + 823 data sources, batch 1 covered 50 resources). 2178 depth-0 field descriptions also still missing -- not started this batch, intros are the more expensive, non-batchable-for-free work per write-artifacts.md's own framing.
